Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class CompanyEventEntity

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.CompanyEventEntity
@Entity public class CompanyEventEntity extends Object
JPA entity representing a row in the company_events table.

Each event links back to a CompanyProfileEntity via companySlug and to a source article via sourceArticleId.
